label: three-fold BDG2 reduced-grid benchmark, model seed 42

combined_analysis.main_exploratory_paired_contrast: static immediate CQR minus static immediate uncalibrated
combined_analysis.workload_pool: sum original clean episodes / sum original asset-days; never multiply exposure by catalogue count
combined_analysis.recall_pool: sum N and TP within each of 21 strata across folds and all catalogues, then equal-stratum mean
combined_analysis.paired_ci: approximate percentile 95%; resample ten original buildings with all fold/catalogue contributions together
combined_analysis.inference: exploratory conditional; no significance/equivalence/same-recall superiority claim
combined_analysis.outer_comparisons: derive from actual frozen selection, fixed controls, independent subsets, inverse and persistence; no reselection
combined_analysis.limitations: post-inspection design; fold 2 already inspected; historical period repeatability, not prospective or unseen buildings

resources.policy: sequential real fits; preserve failure evidence; stop on guard failure; no second-run adaptation to first-run scores
